svg.title: Sieve of Eratosthenes up to 50: multiples of 2, 3, 5 and 7 are crossed out, and the remaining numbers are prime

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Noto Sans', sans-serif

svg.text: Sieve of Eratosthenes: cross out multiples, keep the primes

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Noto Sans', sans-serif

svg.text: For each prime p with p × p ≤ 50 (2, 3, 5, 7), cross out p×p, p×p + p, … Whatever survives is prime.
